art_note: High-end fitness campaign imagery with professional lighting and clean gym environments, showcasing the garment fit and details clearly.
desc_en: Streamlined silhouette featuring graphic star motifs set against a deep black backdrop. High-rise wide waistband for secure support. Soft touch finish delivering lasting comfort. Functional side pockets and a hidden rear interior compartment for essentials. Made-to-order piece with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Diseño depurado con motivos gráficos y estelares sobre fondo negro. Cinturilla ancha de tiro alto para un ajuste firme. Tacto suave y confort duradero. Incorpora bolsillos laterales y un compartimento interior trasero para pequeños esenciales. Pieza confeccionada bajo demanda con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Fabric: soft-touch polyester.
· Waist: high-rise with wide elastic waistband.
· Pockets: two side pockets and one hidden rear interior pocket.
· Made-to-order piece.
details_es:
· Tejido: poliéster de tacto suave.
· Cintura: alta, con cinturilla ancha y elástica.
· Bolsillos: dos laterales y uno interior oculto en la parte trasera.
· Confección bajo demanda.
